paragraphs.text:
For each hour at Miskatonic’s library, attempt to make a successful 
Library Use or Spot Hidden roll: if you make the library Use, 
go to 25; for the Spot Hidden, go to 70. You can return to the 
Miskatonic University, go to 82; or any Arkham Location.
(70, 82, 143)
